Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly swapped the dates of the two battles. It correctly identified the dates from the WebSurfer's search results (Belleau Wood: June 1–26, 1918; Peleliu: September 15–November 27, 1944), but in the "Updated Understanding" section, it erroneously listed "Battle of Belleau Wood: September 15 – November 27, 1944" and "Battle of Peleliu: June 1–26, 1918." Consequently, the final conclusion stated that Peleliu occurred earlier, which is historically false; Belleau Wood (WWI, 1918) occurred decades before Peleliu (WWII, 1944).
